learning_outcomes.text: Students are familiar with the fundamental aspects of structured analysis of electronic circuits. These are necessary for understanding more complex circuits and form the basis for solving electronic problems and synthesizing electronic circuits.

syllabus_topics: Semiconductor components, temperature influence, large-signal and small-signal behavior
Operating point adjustment and temperature stability
Extended basic circuits, differential amplifiers, current mirrors, output stages
Feedback circuits, positive and negative feedback
Power supply circuits, linear and switched power output stages
Heat dissipation and thermal equivalent circuit
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam. The grade contributes 5/138 to the final grade.
